phase: symbolic organization development; not confirmatory evidence
derived_training: all old-world derived queries; identical isolated stream in every condition
loss: 0.8 * mean document answer/EOS CE + 0.2 * mean isolated derived answer/EOS CE
learning_rate_schedule: constant within each complete epoch; lr * min((epoch + 1) / 16, 1)
evaluation: isolated closed-book full-answer generation; learned composition, not unseen-composition generalization
limitations_before_launch: A/B/C identify presentation-package effects, not pure shared-representation mediators.
Company default facts have 32 repetitions per epoch in every condition; budgets differ from historical SA/AS experiments.
The organization randomization is fixed at seed 0 within each independently generated world; model initializations do not add independent data worlds.
All runs receive the same isolated old-world derived queries; derived editing answers are never supervised.
English corpora are rendered and audited as data artifacts; no natural-language or pretrained-LLM training is part of this symbolic development batch.
Hyperparameters, layer window and finite budget are development choices; no hyperparameter search or target-NLL matching has been completed.
No result-dependent extension, seed exclusion, checkpoint selection or early stopping is allowed within this frozen batch.
